audit_items.proof_trace: All READ paths exposing discord_role_id (teams listing in admin/teams/page.tsx and admin/members/page.tsx) are nested inside the admin layout which checks auth AND is_admin, returning an alert (not children) for non-admin users; middleware additionally redirects unauthenticated users before any dashboard route is reached. All exported server actions that return discord_role_id (createTeam, updateTeam, createGenerationRole, updateGenerationRoles) call checkAdmin() as their first statement. The one weakly-authenticated export (ensureGenerationRoleExists) returns void and discards the discord_role_id value from its internal API call.
